Item 8 now applies to every card, in focus or out, so the "或" either makes item 7 dead or lets a grader pick item 7 and skip the focus lowering. The ruling lowers from what "the effect alone would give", which includes item 7's lift: for an out-of-focus card a real user can hit, the two readings give p2 or p3. State the order: item 7 first, then item 8.

S2 (should-fix) — `filing-gate.md:58-59`: the ruling bounds the rule to first touch and retriage and says it "is not run back over the open backlog without a separate word". The item carries no bound and no other line at head supplies one, so a seat touching an older card may regrade it. That widens the rule beyond the ruling.

D4 adds sampling only, and the card's design lists "any change to L2 routing" under not doing; `lanes/skills.md:26` calls a cut with no second home a lost rule. Keep the prohibition, here or in `contract-review.md`.
